title: docs: describe hourly date buckets in daily usage
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Corrected the `/account/usage/daily` `date` field description: with `granularity=day`, the underlying `activity_usage_chart.pipe` uses `grain=hour` and returns hourly `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` buckets, not only `YYYY-MM-DD` dates. The description now matches the earnings schema’s date-or-hourly format. API behavior is unchanged.
